verdict.rationale: As an API product, Sonar is headless by design. Requests use an API key ([docs-37]), and official typed sync/async SDKs ship with automatic retries and structured errors ([gh-2], [gh-3], [gh-5]). The `pplx` CLI returns structured JSON intended for shell pipelines and coding agents ([docs-8], [docs-53]), and versioned effort levels and profiles allow reproducible automated runs ([docs-45], [docs-35]). Missing for 10: explicit CI documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions or env-var auth for the CLI in pipelines), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
